sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reduced: full-year 2026 EPS guided to $12.10-$12.30 versus $13.26 in 2025, and operating margin expected to decrease by approximately 250 basis points. Management explicitly stated that 'an improvement in overall trends in North America will likely progress over the course of the year and into 2027,' indicating a prolonged recovery. The gross margin decline of 550 basis points in Q4 and continued pressure from tariffs and markdowns further support a bearish outlook.

summary.revenue: Q4 total net revenue $3.6 billion, up 1% (or 6% excluding the 53rd week); full-year revenue $11.1 billion, up 5%.
summary.eps: Q4 diluted EPS $5.01 versus $6.14 prior year; full-year diluted EPS $13.26 versus $14.64 prior year.
summary.guidance: Full-year 2026 revenue $11.35B-$11.5B (2%-4% growth); EPS $12.10-$12.30; North America revenue expected down 1%-3%; China Mainland up ~20%; Rest of World up mid-teens.
summary.margin: Q4 gross margin 54.9% (down 550 bps); operating margin 22.3% (down 660 bps). Full-year 2026 gross margin expected to decrease ~120 bps; operating margin expected to decrease ~250 bps.
key_risks: Tariffs: gross tariff cost of $275M in 2025, forecast $380M in 2026 with $160M offsets.
North America revenue expected to decline 1%-3% in 2026.
Gross margin decline of 550 bps in Q4 driven by 560 bps product margin drop, including 520 bps tariff impact and 130 bps higher markdowns.
SG&A deleverage of ~130 bps expected for full-year 2026.
Proxy contest costs and layering back of incentive comp and store labor hours.
key_opportunities: International momentum: China Mainland revenue up 28% in Q4, Rest of World up 12%.
New product innovation: Unrestricted Power, ShowZero, ThermoZen, run capsule collections positively received.
New style penetration increased to 35% in North America spring assortment (from 23% in 2025).
Full-price sales improvement expected to begin in Q2 and turn positive in second half of 2026.
Store expansion: 40-45 net new company-operated stores planned for 2026, with above 100% ROI and payback less than a year.

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management repeatedly hedged forward expectations, stating 'an improvement in overall trends in North America will likely progress over the course of the year and into 2027' and 'we recognize there is more work to be done.'

evidence.claim: Q4 total net revenue was $3.6 billion, up 1% (or 6% excluding the 53rd week).
evidence.quote: Total Net Revenue -- $3.6 billion, up 1%, or 6% excluding the 53rd week; constant currency revenue rose 4% and comparable sales increased 2%.
Full year revenue increased 5% to $11.1 billion.

evidence.claim: Q4 diluted EPS was $5.01 versus $6.14 prior year.
evidence.quote: Net income was $587 million, equating to $5.01 per diluted share, compared to $6.14 per diluted share in the prior period.

evidence.claim: Full-year diluted EPS was $13.26 versus $14.64 prior year.
evidence.quote: Diluted earnings per share were $13.26 compared to $14.64 in 2024.
For 2026, the Company expects net revenue to be in the range of $11.350 billion to $11.500 billion, representing growth of 2% to 4%.

evidence.claim: Full-year 2026 EPS guidance is $12.10-$12.30 versus $13.26 in 2025.
evidence.quote: For the fiscal year 2026, we expect diluted earnings per share in the range of $12.10 to $12.30 versus EPS of $13.26 in 2025.

evidence.claim: North America revenue expected to decline 1%-3% in 2026.
evidence.quote: By region, we expect revenue in North America to be down 1% to 3%, with the U.S. down 1% to 3%.

evidence.claim: Q4 gross margin was 54.9%, down 550 bps.
evidence.quote: Gross profit for the fourth quarter was $2 billion or 54.9% of net revenue compared to 60.4% in Q4 2024. Our gross margin decreased 550 basis points relative to last year.

evidence.claim: Q4 operating margin was 22.3%, down 660 bps.
evidence.quote: Operating income for the quarter was approximately $812 million, or 22.3% of net revenue compared to 28.9% of net revenue in Q4 2024.

evidence.claim: Full-year 2026 operating margin expected to decrease ~250 bps.
evidence.quote: When looking at operating margins for the full year 2026, we expect it to decrease by approximately 250 basis points versus last year.

evidence.claim: Tariffs: gross tariff cost $275M in 2025, forecast $380M in 2026 with $160M offsets.
evidence.quote: For reference, in 2025, gross tariff costs were $275 million. ... Looking to 2026, we anticipate gross tariff impact of approximately $380 million with offsets from our enterprise efficiency initiatives of approximately $160 million within gross margin.

evidence.claim: China Mainland revenue up 28% in Q4.
evidence.quote: In China Mainland, revenue increased 28% with comparable sales increasing 26%.

evidence.claim: Rest of World revenue up 12% in Q4.
evidence.quote: And in the Rest of World, revenue grew by 12% and comparable sales increased by 5%.

evidence.claim: New style penetration increased to 35% in North America spring assortment.
evidence.quote: New Styles Penetration -- Increased to 35% in North America in the spring assortment, up from 23% in 2025, with the shift attributed to new products rather than refreshed colorways.

evidence.claim: Management tone is cautious, hedging recovery timeline.
evidence.quote: Meghan Frank: ...I want to also acknowledge that an improvement in overall trends in North America will likely progress over the course of the year and into 2027 as we return to a healthier baseline of full-price sales.

evidence.claim: Forward guidance was reduced: EPS guided lower year-over-year.
evidence.quote: For the fiscal year 2026, we expect diluted earnings per share in the range of $12.10 to $12.30 versus EPS of $13.26 in 2025.

evidence.claim: Store expansion: 40-45 net new stores planned for 2026 with above 100% ROI.
evidence.quote: Globally, we expect to open approximately 40 to 45 net new company-operated stores in 2026 ... NSOs are returning at above 100% ROI across both North America and the international markets. So representing a payback period of less than a year.

evidence.claim: Full-price sales improvement expected to begin in Q2 and turn positive in second half.
evidence.quote: We'd expect positive year-over-year growth in full price to begin in Q2 and continue into the second half, driven by the rollout of new styles, innovations and core updates over the course of the year.

review_flags.reason: The score of -0.50 is based on reduced EPS guidance and cautious tone, but the document also shows strong international growth and new product momentum which could be seen as offsetting factors. A reviewer may want to assess whether the negative weighting is appropriate.
